concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtlanan üç yapıya bağlı isteği birlikte gösteren açıklayıcı bir üst anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı amacı, istek ilişkisini ve katılımcı farklarını korur.

concept_gloss.text: yardım isteme, sorma veya salmak için çağırma

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda yardım için seslenmek, birine sorarak bilgi istemek veya köpeği salmak amacıyla çağırmaktır. Üç kullanımın ortak yanı bir karşılık ya da hareket istemesidir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğa yardım istemek için seslenilir.
Bir kişiye soru yöneltilerek bilgi istenir.
Bir köpek, ardından salınması amacıyla çağrılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğa seslenip onlardan yardım istenen kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Seslenilen topluluğu ve yardım isteme amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiden soru yoluyla bilgi edinmenin anlatıldığı bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Soru yöneltme ve bilgi edinme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız köpeğin çağrılıp ardından gönderildiği özel kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Köpek katılımcısını, çağırmayı ve salma amacını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız yapıya bağlı üç istek kullanımını kapsar; genel sorma, çağırma veya gizli bildirme anlamına genişlemez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı türemiş yapı çevresinde yardım için seslenme, bilgi sorma ve köpeği salmak üzere çağırma kullanımlarını verir. Bunlar istek ortaklığıyla gruplanabilir, fakat tek bir eylem gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yardım isteme, bilgi sorma ve köpeği salmak için çağırma ayrı yapılara bağlı anlamlar olarak korunur; bunlardan genel bir yalın kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel sorma ve yardım çığlığı komşuları üç yapıya bağlı kullanımın sınırlarını en açık biçimde ortaya koyar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel soru ve istek komşu dalın çekirdeğidir; bu dalda ise yalnız belirli türemiş yapıların üç ayrı kullanımı kanıtlanmıştır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bilgi sormanın yanında yardım çağrısı ve köpeği salmak için çağırma kullanımlarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yapıya bağlı isteme ile genel sorma
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesne veya kişi hakkında genel soru ve istek alanını, çok soru sormayı da kapsayarak kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir kişiden sözlü olarak bilgi veya karşılık istemede örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal belirli çığlık biçimini adlandırır; bu dal ise yardım istemeyi yalnız üç yapıya bağlı anlamdan biri olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yardım istemenin yanında bilgi sorma ve hayvanı salmaya yönelik çağırmayı da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir yüksek yardım çığlığını ve onun seslenme sözünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sıkıntı anında başkalarından yardım istemek için seslenebilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: استوحيناهم أي استصرخناهم (sihah)؛ استوحيته أي استفهمته (tahdhib)؛ استوحيت الكلب إذا دعوته لترسله (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birlikte sunduğu alan, karşı taraftan yardım, bilgi veya hareket istemeye yarayan üç ayrı yapıdır; her kullanım kendi katılımcı ve amacıyla korunmalıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: استوحى بمعنى استصرخ أو استفهم، واستوحى الكلب إذا دعاه ليرسله
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس إيصال علم إلى غير ولا سرعة مجردة ولا كتابة

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

error_profile.loses: Tek tek kullanımların özel göndergelerini kavram karşılığının içine ayrı ayrı taşımaz.
error_profile.preserves: Dalın özel, yalıtık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma niteliğini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal tek bir kavram değildir: hükümdar olma, yönetimde zulmetme, hükümdar adı ve ateş adı ayrıştırılmalıdır. Yarar ve zarar verme bakımından kurulan hükümdar-ateş benzetmesi yalnız son iki kaydı ilişkilendirir.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin yoksulluktan sonra hükümdar olması ayrı bir eylem kaydıdır.
Bir yöneticinin yönetimi sırasında zulmetmesi ayrı bir eylem kaydıdır.
Hükümdar ve ateş ayrı adlandırmalardır; yarar ve zarar verme benzetmesi aralarında bağ kurar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kişinin yoksulluktan hükümdarlığa geçtiğini anlatan eylem kaydına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıç durumunu ve hükümdar olma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız bir yöneticinin gücünü haksızlık için kullandığı eylem kaydına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yönetici katılımcısını ve yönetimdeki haksızlığı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birbirine indirgenemeyen iki ad kaydını, kaynakta verilen yarar ve zarar benzetmesini zorlamadan ayrı gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Hükümdar ve ateş adlarının ayrı gönderimlerini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dal yalnız sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma malzemesini tuttuğu için yayımlanacak güvenilir komşu ayrımı seçilmedi.

source_note.TA: Dalın hükümdar olma, zulmetme, hükümdar ve ateş kayıtlarının tamamı tek kaynakta birlikte yer alır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أوحى الإنسان إذا صار ملكا بعد فقر؛ أوحى الإنسان ووحى وأحى إذا ظلم في سلطانه؛ الوحى النار؛ يقال للملك وحى؛ الوحى النار فكأنه مثل النار ينفع ويضر

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

source_details.summary: Dalın hükümdar olma, zulmetme, hükümdar ve ateş kayıtlarının tamamı tek kaynakta birlikte yer alır.

branches.what_is_ar: الملك، والنار، وما يشبه به السلطان النافع الضار، وفعل الظلم في السلطان
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الوحي بمعنى الإعلام أو الإشارة أو الكتابة

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın ağlamayı ve belirli bir ölü için yas sesi çıkarmayı katılımcı farkıyla birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Ağlama çekirdeğini, yas bağlamını ve ardından ağlanan kişiyi korur.

concept_gloss.text: ağlama ve ölünün ardından ağıt yakma

concept_map.definition: Ağlamak veya belirli bir kişinin, özellikle bir ölünün ardından ağlayıp ağıt yakmaktır. İkinci kullanımda yas tutan ile ardından ağlanan kişi ayrı katılımcılardır.

facets.statement: Yalın kullanım ağlama eylemini adlandırır.
Geçişli kullanımda bir kişinin, özellikle ölünün ardından ağlanır ve ağıt yakılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin belirli bir kişi için yas tutma yapısına bağlanmadığı yalın kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Yalın ağlama eylemini ek koşul getirmeden korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yas tutan kişinin bir ölünün ardından sesli biçimde ağladığı kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Yas tutanı, ölüyü ve sesli ağlama eylemini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel ses alanını değil, ağlama ile bir ölünün ardından ağlayıp ağıt yakma eylemini kapsar.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem ağlamayı hem de bir kişinin, özellikle ölünün ardından ağlayıp ağıt yakmayı verir. Geçici dal çerçevesi uygundur, ancak yalın ağlama ile belirli bir kişi için yas tutan geçişli kullanım ayrılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ağlama anlamı, baba veya ölü ardından ağlamayı anlatan yapıya bağlı kullanımlardan ayrı tutulur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; geniş ağlama alanı ve ağlama sesi komşuları, eylem ile yas yapısının sınırlarını en açık biçimde gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal ağlamanın neden, ses ve gözyaşı görünümlerini genişçe toplar; bu dal ise yalın ağlamayla birlikte belirli biri ardından yas tutan yapıları kaydeder.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir kişi veya ölü ardından ağlamayı anlatan özel geçişli yapıları içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal üzüntü, gözyaşı, ağlama sesi ve insan dışı varlıklara aktarılan ağlama dahil daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ağlama eylemini ve ölü ardından duyulan üzüntüyü kapsayabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal eylem ve yas ilişkisini kurar; komşu dal ise aynı olayın işitilen ses görünümünü çekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ağlama eylemini ve bir ölünün ardından ağıt yakmayı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle ağlamanın duyulan sesini veya göğüste yinelenen sesli kesilmeyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Sesli ağlama ve ağıt sırasında iki dal aynı olayda gerçekleşebilir.

source_note.TA: Ağlama ve ölünün ardından ağıt yakma kullanımlarının tamamı tek kaynakta tanıklanmıştır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الإيحاء البكاء؛ فلان يوحي أباه أي يبكيه؛ النائحة توحي الميت تنوح عليه

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaktaki kayıt ağlamayı genel eylem olarak verir ve bunu baba ya da ölü ardından ağlama ile ağıt yakma yapılarına genişletir.

source_details.summary: Ağlama ve ölünün ardından ağıt yakma kullanımlarının tamamı tek kaynakta tanıklanmıştır.

branches.what_is_ar: الإيحاء بمعنى البكاء أو جعل المرثي مبكيا، ونياحة النائحة على الميت
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الصوت مطلقا ولا الإعلام الخفي ولا السرعة

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız sır tutma ve apaçıklık bildiren iki kalıplaşmış kullanımın ortak görüntüsünü adlandırır.

error_profile.preserves: Taş yazısı görüntüsünü ve ondan çıkan iki ayrı yorumu korur.

concept_map.definition: Taşa kazınmış yazı görüntüsüne dayanan iki kalıplaşmış benzetmedir. Birincisi sırrı değişmeden saklayan kişiyi, ikincisi ise kazınmış bir yazı kadar açık ve görünür olan şeyi anlatır.

facets.statement: İlk kalıp, sırrını güvenle saklayan kişi için söylenir.
İkinci kalıp, taşa kazınmış yazı kadar açık ve görünür şeyi anlatır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sırrını dışarı vermeden saklayan kişi için kullanılan ilk kalıba doğal bir bağlamsal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendisine verilen sırrı güvenle saklamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin kazınmış yazı gibi belirgin ve inkâr edilemez olduğunu anlatan ikinci kalıba uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Taşa kazınma görüntüsünü ve güçlü görünürlük sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız iki taş yazısı kalıbını kapsar; genel sır saklama, açıklık veya yazma anlamına genişletilemez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi taşa kazınmış yazı görüntüsüne bağlı iki kalıplaşmış sözü doğrular: biri sırrı tutmayı, diğeri kazınmış şeyin apaçıklığını anlatır. Aynı görüntüye dayansalar da karşıt sonuçları tek anlam gibi sunmamak gerekir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sırrını güvenle saklayan kişi için söylenen söz

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım iki kalıplaşmış taş yazısı benzetmesine sıkı biçimde bağlıdır; bunlardan yalın yazı, sır veya açıklık anlamı türetilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel gizlilik, ün kaynaklı görünürlük ve gerçek yazma komşuları iki kalıbın ayrı sonuçlarını ve yapıya bağlı sınırını açıklar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal gizliliğin genel alanıdır; bu dalda gizlilik yalnız sırrını saklayan kişiye yönelik taş yazısı benzetmesinin sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sırrı yalnız taş yazısı görüntüsüne bağlı tek bir kalıplaşmış söz içinde ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sır tutma benzetmesi ile genel gizlilik
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sır, iç dünya ve gizli konuşma alanını genel sözlük anlamlarıyla kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir bilginin başkalarına açılmaması ve gizli kalması alanında buluşur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirginliği kazınmış yazının görünürlüğünden çıkarır; komşu dal ise ün ve tanınmışlık nedeniyle gizlenememeyi çekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal apaçıklığı yalnız taşa kazınmış yazı benzetmesiyle anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin veya işin gizlenemeyecek ölçüde tanınmış ve görünür olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir şeyin saklanamayacak kadar belirgin olmasını anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal gerçek yazma eylemi ve ürünüdür; bu dal aynı görüntüden sır tutma ve apaçıklık sonuçları çıkaran iki kalıpla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal taşa kazınmış yazıyı iki kalıplaşmış benzetmenin görüntüsü olarak kullanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: taş yazısı benzetmesi ile gerçek yazma
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yüzeye yazma veya kazıma eylemini ve ortaya çıkan yazılı ürünü doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak somut görüntüsü taş üzerine geçirilmiş yazıdır.

source_note.TA: Sır saklama ve apaçıklık bildiren iki taş yazısı kalıbı aynı tek kaynakta tanıklanmıştır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: وحي في حجر يضرب مثلا لمن يكتم سره؛ هو كالوحي في الحجر إذا نقر فيه نقرا

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak, taş üzerindeki kalıcı yazı görüntüsünü iki ayrı kalıpta kullanır; kalıcılık birinde sır tutmaya, görünürlük diğerinde apaçıklığa dayanak olur.

source_details.summary: Sır saklama ve apaçıklık bildiren iki taş yazısı kalıbı aynı tek kaynakta tanıklanmıştır.

Hükümdarlık, ateş ve yönetimde zulüm kayıtlarını birleştiren dal ise yapısal ayrıştırma gerektirir.

text.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ

baseline.text: Bu, sana vahyettiğimiz bilinmeyen haberlerdendir. Onlar işlerine karar verip tuzak kurarken sen yanlarında değildin.

findings.text: Muhatabın gizli toplantıda bulunmaması, vahyin sıradan tanıklığın ulaşamadığı olayı haber olarak taşıyan açıkça belirtilmiş kanıt kanalı olmasıyla karşılanır.

activation_trace.role: The branch's delivered incoming report supplies the content that must cross the epistemic gap.
The branch's hiding from eyes or knowledge defines the barrier traversed by the report.
The branch's covert imparting of knowledge supplies the transmission channel.
The branch's occurrence and presence in time is negated, making actual co-presence unavailable.

changed_reading.after: The verse stages revelation as a transport operation that gives an absent recipient access to a concealed event without converting him into an eyewitness.
changed_reading.before: The verse gives information about an unseen past.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain "anba al-ghayb nuhihi ilayk" is followed by the explicit denial that the addressee was present with them.
baseline_models.mechanism: An incoming report supplies the payload, concealment blocks ordinary sight or knowledge, and a hidden imparting carries that payload to a recipient who did not share the event's time and place. Revelation functions as epistemic transport across non-presence.

activation_trace.role: The branch's gathering of dispersed opinion into firm resolve supplies the council's decision mechanism.
The branch's consultation and managed deliberation makes their affair a worked-out course of action.
The branch's mutual backing on an affair supplies the coalition that sustains the scheme.

changed_reading.after: The group converted dispersed judgment into a mutually backed, settled program; plotting is presented as a coordinated institution of action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "idh ajmau amrahum wa-hum yamkurun" joins a completed collective resolution to ongoing scheming.
baseline_models.mechanism: Scattered opinions are gathered into a firm resolve, consultation turns an affair into an agreed program, and mutual alignment makes the scheme social and organized rather than a flash of individual cunning.

activation_trace.role: The branch's occlusion supplies the common medium in which both the council and its disclosure are hidden.
The branch's hidden knowledge-transfer makes secrecy a means of disclosure rather than only concealment.
The branch's coalition around an affair supplies the socially closed circuit being exposed.
The branch's temporal presence, explicitly denied, marks the outsider position from which the closed circuit is nevertheless known.

changed_reading.after: The verse contraposes a concealed human council with a concealed disclosure that penetrates it, making revelation a counter-secrecy.
changed_reading.before: The unseen story and the brothers' plot are two adjacent facts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concealed report and its hidden transmission stand over against an absent observer and a closed collective council.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two hidden circuits face each other: human collaborators close around a shared affair, while covert imparting opens that same council to one who was not there. The first secrecy protects a scheme; the second secrecy defeats its enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The branch's movement from place to place lets the report function as something that arrives across separation.
The branch's hidden imparting supplies the focus verse's nonsensory carrier of knowledge.
The branch's exit from a place launches the sequence across a spatial break.
The branch's smell or scent supplies a remote trace recognized before visual contact.
The branch's joy-opening news gives the arriving bearer a message-bearing function.
The branch's casting supplies the physical transfer that mediates the perceptual change.
The branch's return to a prior state supplies restoration rather than acquisition of an unrelated faculty.
The branch's ocular seeing names the perception restored by the carried trace.

changed_reading.after: Revelation behaves like a carried trace of the absent event: it arrives across separation and re-enables perception without erasing the recipient's original absence.
changed_reading.before: Revelation carries propositions about an absent event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence embodies knowing across absence: a caravan departs, scent carries a nonvisual trace, a bearer arrives, an object is cast, and sight returns. This revises revelatory transport from an abstract message channel into a trace-bearing arrival that can restore perception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mobile scent-trace and restored sight; I infer an analogy from that sensory transport to revelatory transport. A live alternative is that 12:94-96 illustrates family recognition only and does not specify the epistemology of 12:102.
structural_cues: 12:94-96 runs from separation through remote recognition and arrival to restored sight.
12:102 similarly orders concealed content, transmission toward a recipient, and denied co-presence.

activation_trace.role: The branch's buried roots supply a latent structure whose visible effects emerge only later.
The branch's consequential report carries the retrospective account of that hidden structure.
The branch's return to an end or outcome makes later fulfillment organize the earlier sequence.
The branch's stable correspondence with reality supplies the fit between prior vision and realized event.
The branch's fineness and hiddenness supplies an unobtrusive process operating beneath conspicuous events.
The branch's exact construction and coherence supplies the sequence's ordered fit.
The branch's ever-renewed report turns events into transmissible retrospective speech.

changed_reading.after: The report also reconstructs the latent order by which scattered events acquire a coherent outcome that the conspirators could not see.
changed_reading.before: The report exposes what conspirators privately decided.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fulfilled interpretation gathers dispersed episodes by their outcome, while subtle hidden action and exact correspondence make that outcome intelligible. The focus report therefore discloses not only a secret meeting but a fine-grained order that becomes readable retrospectively.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fulfillment, subtlety, ordered wisdom, and reportable events; I infer that the focus disclosure reveals causal architecture as well as backstage facts. A live alternative is that subtlety marks benevolent kindness without implying a hidden event-order.
structural_cues: 12:100 explicitly links an earlier vision to a now-realized outcome and then names hidden subtlety, knowledge, and wisdom.
12:101 places taught interpretation of events immediately before the deictic opening of 12:102.

activation_trace.role: The branch's consolidation of dispersed opinions supplies unanimity without itself certifying the decision.
The branch's mutual backing explains how a group can reinforce a shared but misleading course.
The branch's numerical abundance supplies the first explicit majority that nevertheless fails to believe.
The branch's manifest sign supplies evidence that is available rather than intrinsically hidden.
The branch's passing across something supplies contact without uptake.
The branch's turning the side away supplies the attentional refusal that neutralizes visible evidence.
The repeated branch of numerical abundance extends the warning from unbelief to compromised belief.
The branch's association with God supplies the internal contradiction carried by the majority's professed belief.

changed_reading.after: Their unanimity becomes an epistemic warning: agreement and prevalence can organize shared blindness just as effectively as shared action.
changed_reading.before: Their unanimity mainly shows that the plot was efficiently coordinated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus council achieves unanimity, but the following sequence repeatedly separates numerical prevalence from truth: the many do not believe, visible signs are passed while attention turns aside, and prevalent belief remains internally partnered. Collective convergence can therefore be a mechanism of concealment rather than a warrant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unanimous plotting, majority unbelief, overlooked signs, and compromised belief; I infer a critique of consensus as evidence. A live alternative is that the later majority language concerns reception of the message without commenting on the earlier council's decision procedure.
structural_cues: The plural council in 12:102 is followed by repeated majority constructions in 12:103 and 12:106.
12:105 places manifest signs, passing over them, and active turning away in one construction.

activation_trace.role: The branch's coalition around an affair supplies the closed group that initially controls the secret.
The branch's delivered report supplies the release of coalition-held knowledge.
The branch's wage or compensation, explicitly denied, removes a transactional gate from transmission.
The branch's reminder gives the disclosed story a public recollective purpose rather than a private intelligence value.

changed_reading.after: Revelation breaks the council's monopoly on its secret and converts hidden intelligence into an uncompensated public reminder.
changed_reading.before: Revelation lets one absent recipient know a private event.

context_deltas.mechanism: A privately consolidated affair is exposed through a report whose transmission seeks no payment and is characterized as reminder rather than proprietary intelligence. The informational architecture changes from coalition-held secrecy to openly directed recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closed coalition, disclosure, no wage, and universal reminder; I infer that openness counters the council's information enclosure. A live alternative is that the no-wage statement concerns messenger integrity only, without an information-access contrast.
structural_cues: 12:102 moves knowledge out of a closed council; 12:104 immediately denies a fee and directs the reminder to the worlds.
The singular report is thus framed by a plural secret source and an unrestricted destination.

activation_trace.role: The branch's hiding from sight or knowledge supplies the focus category that the context redistributes into attention.
The branch's sign-like indication supplies a mode of disclosure that still requires attentive uptake.
The branch's visible marker establishes that the missed evidence is exposed rather than absent.
The branch's traversal supplies proximity without perception.
The branch's bodily turning-away supplies the active production of non-attention.
The branch's comprehensive covering supplies the consequence that suddenly occupies the whole perceptual field.
The branch's suddenness converts prior inattention into experienced surprise.
The branch's fine awareness, here denied, names the missing capacity between visible sign and sudden consequence.

changed_reading.after: The unseen also diagnoses how observers make available signs absent to themselves through passing contact, active turning, and deficient awareness.
changed_reading.before: The unseen is what no ordinary observer could access because the event is absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs can become functionally unseen when people merely pass them and turn aside; what remains outside awareness can then arrive as an enveloping surprise. The focus's unseen is widened from inaccessible past event to an epistemic condition also produced by inattention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs ignored until an unperceived sudden event; I infer that contextual inattention is an analogue of the focus's non-presence. A live alternative is that ghayb remains specifically historical or metaphysical while 12:105-107 describes a separate moral failure.
structural_cues: 12:105 repeats pronominal contact with signs while contrasting passing over them and turning away from them.
12:107 joins comprehensive arrival, suddenness, and lack of awareness.

activation_trace.role: The branch's clear road supplies the report's function as a route through an otherwise inaccessible scene.
The branch's extended traversable path turns disclosure into a declared way of proceeding.
The branch's inward discernment supplies the path's epistemic posture.
The branch's divine news and inspiration repeats the focus channel across earlier human messengers.
The branch's movement through space supplies active encounter with historical traces.
The branch's directed sight or insight supplies deliberate inspection rather than passive reception.
The branch's final outcome supplies the object that travel and looking are asked to assess.
The branch's following of a trace supplies the narrative method of reconstructing absent action.
The branch's lesson by carrying one condition across to another supplies transferable inference.
The branch's disclosure of parts and meanings supplies articulated rather than opaque guidance.

changed_reading.after: Revelation enables disciplined non-eyewitness knowing: it gives a route into the absent event, directs inspection of its traces and outcomes, and carries its pattern into new cases.
changed_reading.before: Revelation simply replaces the eyewitness access the addressee lacked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The revealed report opens onto a method: a path grounded in insight, repeated revelation to earlier messengers, movement through the land, directed inspection of outcomes, tracking narrated traces, crossing from one case to another, and articulated detail. Non-eyewitness knowledge is transmitted, but it remains oriented toward public traces and transferable reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revelation, path, insight, travel, inspection, outcomes, traced narrative, and lesson; I infer an epistemic workflow connecting received report to public traces and analogical judgment. A live alternative is that travel and looking are exhortative confirmation rather than a method for testing the report.
structural_cues: 12:108 moves from declared path to insight and following.
12:109 repeats revelation, then commands travel and looking at outcomes.
12:111 characterizes narrated absence as trace-following, transferable lesson, and detailed guidance rather than fabricated speech.

activation_trace.role: The branch's firm collected resolve supplies the plotters' sense that the affair has been closed.
The branch's deliberative management supplies the human program whose horizon appears complete.
The branch's severed hope supplies the temporal limit at which no counter-event seems available.
The branch's arrival supplies the event that reopens the apparently closed sequence.
The branch's aid and vindication identifies the counter-arrival's effective force.
The branch's rescue by separation supplies an outcome that extracts some from the enclosing crisis.
The branch's pushing back or prevention, here denied, makes the counter-force irreversible.

changed_reading.after: The coordinated plot determines only a provisional phase; the full affair includes an unseen counter-arrival beyond the plotters' temporal horizon.
changed_reading.before: The coordinated plot determines the affair it has settled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus council closes around a settled program, whereas the later temporal sequence stretches to exhausted expectation and then marks help as an arrival that separates survivors and cannot be pushed back. Human closure is reread as only a provisional middle inside a longer, unseen sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human closure, exhausted expectation, arriving help, rescue, and non-repulsion; I infer that the latter sequence relativizes the plotters' horizon. A live alternative is that 12:110 states a general messenger pattern without directly redescribing the brothers' council.
structural_cues: 12:102 places completed resolution beside ongoing plotting.
12:110 uses an extended "until, when" threshold followed by abrupt arrival, rescue, and denied repulsion.

remaining_uncertainties: The transport and restored-sight analogy is structurally strong but does not prove that 12:94-96 defines revelation's mechanism.
The reading of subtlety as latent causal order competes with the simpler sense of benevolent kindness.
The critique of consensus is abductive because the later majority is not grammatically identified with the earlier council.
The ground-preparation, root-system, and scented-road models are deliberately contained branch activations and should not be presented as lexical translations.
strongest_changes: Revelation became a transport operation across non-presence, then the preceding scent, bearer, and restored sight sequence made that operation trace-like and perceptually restorative.
The private plot became coordinated consensus rather than isolated cunning, while the later majority and overlooked-sign sequence showed that agreement and prevalence can organize blindness.
The report became a disciplined route from concealed event to inspectable traces, outcomes, analogical crossing, and articulated guidance.
Retrospective fulfillment and hidden subtlety changed the disclosed object from a secret meeting alone into the latent order connecting scattered events.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse contains two rival hidden circuits: coordinated human secrecy and hidden disclosure. The pericope repeatedly converts absence into mediated perception, private information into public reminder, apparent closure into delayed counter-arrival, and narrated past into a path for seeing and inference.

activation_trace.role: The branch's watering of hard land before cultivation supplies a material model of conditioning circumstances before decisive action.
The branch's firm collection of judgment supplies the intended operation for which the field is prepared.
The branch's deliberative planning supplies the directed agency behind the preparation.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, their scheming preconditions a resistant social field so that the already-settled objective can later be worked into it.
changed_reading.before: Their scheming is hidden cleverness directed at a settled objective.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch of watering hard ground before ploughing rather than treating it as the ordinary lexical gloss of scheming. It remains anchored in the exact focus verb and gains functional support from the adjacent settled deliberation; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for preparatory conditioning, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ongoing verb "yamkurun" follows the group's completed consolidation of its affair.

activation_trace.role: The branch's buried roots supply a concealed generative network inferred from what later appears above ground.
The branch's minuteness and hiddenness supplies the fine scale at which the latent network operates.
The branch's tracking of an effect back along its trace supplies the reader's access to the buried network.

changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, the unseen is a buried root-system of relations whose visible outcomes can be traced but whose generative links require disclosure.
changed_reading.before: The unseen is an archive of facts hidden from the observer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it activates concealed tree roots as an image for ghayb. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is sharpened by contextual fineness and trace-following; downstream prose should mark it as an ecological analogy for latent causation, not as the lexical sense of the phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names the disclosed material "anba al-ghayb," then narrates an otherwise inaccessible causal interior.

activation_trace.role: The branch's coming from one place to another supplies the report's mobility.
The branch's clear road supplies the report's navigable route through absent history.
The branch's scent supplies a trace that travels ahead of direct encounter.
The branch's extended path supplies a declared route along which the trace can be followed.
The branch's travel supplies the recipient's active movement along the report's route toward visible outcomes.

changed_reading.after: As a contained transport metaphor, the report is a mobile trace and a road: it reaches the absent reader, then teaches that reader how to travel toward the event's surviving effects.
changed_reading.before: The report contains remote historical information.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the report's movement and road branches with scent, path, and travel into a quasi-spatial model. It remains anchored in the focus report and in the pericope's repeated carriers and routes; downstream prose should qualify it as a transport metaphor, not imply that revelation is literally sensory residue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The report of the unseen is directed toward an absent recipient.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Hidden news crosses absence through hidden imparting.** ن ب ء B002, غ ي ب B001, and و ح ي B001/B004 make revelation the transmission channel for an event inaccessible by presence. I infer that the listener’s non-presence is not a defect once news is supplied by this route.
2. **Concerted resolve becomes the concealed object later disclosed.** ج م ع B003 (concerted resolve) and ء م ر B001/B007 (affair; deliberation) return to the brothers’ gathering at 12:15. The ayah reads their hidden planning as exactly the kind of latent event revelation makes available.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:111 confirmed that this unseen report is not fabricated حديث but a detailed, confirming account.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Revelation bridging a scene inaccessible to ordinary witness.** `ن ب ء:B002` is consequential report or news, `غ ي ب:B001` is what is hidden from sight or knowledge, and `و ح ي:B004` is divine message or inspiration. The demonstrative recategorizes the foregoing account as unseen report, while the explicit denial of the addressee's presence at the brothers' collective plotting removes eyewitness access. The packet supplies both the inaccessible event and the named channel; I infer that revelation is assigned the evidentiary role that ordinary presence cannot perform. The ayah changes narrative detail from an implied observer's reconstruction into reported knowledge whose warrant is overtly identified.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:111 explicitly denies that the account is fabricated and assigns it confirmation and clarification, validating the unseen-report claim here through the final statement of narrative function.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative compressing the completed Yusuf narrative into a single report-object
words.prose: {{ar:ذَلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) turns the completed Yusuf narrative into one grammatical subject and holds it at a reverent distance. The first word therefore shifts the listener from the story world into a certification frame: that whole narrated arc is now the thing classified as unseen report and carried forward as revelation.

topics.headline: retrospective pointer to the whole story
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by packaging the entire preceding narrative as one object of knowledge, not by continuing the plot.
topics.reason: The QAC demonstrative and attachment evidence support the word as the nominal starting subject, while the CRITICAL rows converge on retrospective compression and boundary shift.

words.gloss_range: partitive and source preposition assigning the prior story to the class of unseen reports
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the prior story a member of a larger class and also lets it come from that hidden domain. The small preposition is the classificatory hinge: the narrative is not merely remembered, it is assigned to the category of unseen reports.

topics.headline: partitive source classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the completed story reclassified as one instance from a wider unseen-news category.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the report noun as predicate complement, and the CRITICAL rows coherently preserve partitive, source, and boundary-bridge payoff.

words.gloss_range: plural construct report noun; weighty tidings from the unseen rather than routine narration
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْبَاءِ}} ({{tr:anbāʾi}}) is the plural construct head of the phrase, so the story enters a recognized class of weighty reports bound to the unseen. Its root field keeps report-bearing and prophetic disclosure audible, while repeated formulas at 11:49 and 3:44 show that this is a credential pattern for histories the Prophet could not witness. The same report root also recalls Joseph’s promised disclosure at 12:15, now reframed as revelation to the Prophet.
words.root_gloss_range: reporting, informing, consequential news, and prophetic news-bearing; here selected as plural unseen reports

topics.headline: unseen-report credential formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the noun as the core of a formula that authenticates inaccessible sacred history.
topics.reason: Construct grammar binds the noun to the unseen qualifier, and the inter-ayah rows explicitly tie the phrase to 11:49 and 3:44.

topics.headline: weighty plural report noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this as consequential tidings in a plural report class, not as ordinary story information.
topics.reason: The lexical rows distinguish weighty report from routine report, while the plural and hamzated form keep the report-root visibly and audibly active.

topics.headline: report-root echoes across disclosure scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root links internal narrative disclosure at 12:15 with the Prophet’s received report in 12:102.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references for the same root field and do not force a different local sense.

words.gloss_range: definite gerund naming the inaccessible unseen domain that qualifies the reports
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}) makes hiddenness the defining genitive domain of the reports. Its definite gerund form presents one known field of inaccessible knowledge, not scattered secrets, and that hiddenness becomes the premise for the proof that follows: the Prophet was not with them. Surah-local echoes from 12:10 and 12:81 move the root from physical concealment and human limitation into this final epistemic category.
words.root_gloss_range: absence, hiddenness, concealment, and what is beyond perception or knowledge; here the epistemic unseen

topics.headline: definite unseen domain in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reports as belonging to a recognized unseen domain rather than to ordinary past memory.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the genitive qualifier of the report noun; CRITICAL rows support definiteness, singularity, and gerund force.

topics.headline: hiddenness set against non-presence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the later absence clause matters: hidden content plus no witness route creates the proof logic.
topics.reason: The local sequence puts the hidden domain before the revelation verb and the denied presence clause, matching the CRITICAL proof-logic rows.

topics.headline: local and cross-surah unseen field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word gathers earlier hiddenness in Surah 12 and the repeated unseen-report formulas at 11:49 and 3:44.
topics.reason: The cited rows provide concrete references and preserve the same hidden-knowledge field without overriding the local genitive role.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect revelation verb with divine subject, story object, and directed recipient frame
words.prose: {{ar:نُوحِيهِ}} ({{tr:nūḥīhi}}) is the ayah’s transmission hub: the divine plural subject reveals the compressed story-object toward the addressed Prophet. The Form IV imperfect keeps revelation active and directed, answering the hiddenness just named and the non-presence about to be denied. Accepted variant evidence with {{ar:يُوحِيهِ}} ({{tr:yūḥīhi}}) preserves the same transitive revelation grammar while shifting the speaker stance from direct divine “We” to third-person “He.” The word also completes the unseen-report formula shared with 11:49 and 3:44 and echoes the surah’s revelation frame at 12:3 and 12:109.
words.root_gloss_range: covert directed communication, signaling, inspiration, and divine revelation; here divine transmission of the prior story

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted recitational contrast shifting the revelation verb to third-person singular while preserving transitive revelation grammar

topics.headline: divine transmission of the story-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exactly how hidden report becomes knowable: a divine subject sends the prior story-object to a prophetic recipient.
topics.reason: The suffix, verb agreement, and following recipient phrase are all supported by QAC and attachment evidence, and the CRITICAL rows converge on source-object-recipient structure.

topics.headline: Form IV directed revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears revelation as covert directed communication crossing hidden access, not as ordinary retelling.
topics.reason: V4 and CRITICAL lexical rows support the range of hidden directed signaling while the local Form IV and prophetic frame select divine revelation.

topics.headline: variant speaker-stance contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted recitation evidence can shift grammatical speaker stance without changing the local revelation mechanism.
topics.reason: The canonical surface is first-person plural; the variant is retained as a recitational contrast, not allowed to replace the local displayed form.

topics.headline: unseen-report and surah revelation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this verb as both the formula’s transmission verb and a closing certification of the surah’s revelation frame.
topics.reason: The rows cite 11:49, 3:44, 12:3, and 12:109 as concrete parallels for the same revelation pattern.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition plus second-person suffix marking the Prophet as revelation recipient
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْكَ}} ({{tr:ilayka}}) lands the revelation vector on the second-person addressee. The word fuses direction with address, so the Prophet is first marked as recipient and then, in the next clause, as the one who was not present at the hidden scene.

topics.headline: second-person revelation endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same addressee is both the endpoint of revelation and the non-witness of the event.
topics.reason: The preposition and suffix attach to the revelation verb and prepare the following second-person absence clause.

words.gloss_range: connector joining the revelation claim to the non-presence warrant
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the revelation claim to the witness-absence clause. Its light connector form makes non-presence part of the same proof unit: the ayah moves from what is revealed to why revelation is the only route to knowing it.

topics.headline: connector from revelation to warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the absence clause as evidence for the revelation claim, not as a detached biographical note.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows coordination or circumstantial force, and both readings preserve the CRITICAL payoff that the clauses form one proof unit.

words.gloss_range: past-negating particle scoping over the whole witness-absence clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates the whole past presence claim, not just a bare verb. With the perfect verb that follows, it states a categorical witness-route denial: the Prophet was not with them at the decisive scene.

topics.headline: categorical past non-presence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof depends on denying the entire past state of presence at the scene.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as past negation before the perfect verb, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the scope and formulaic authentication payoff.

words.gloss_range: negated perfect second-person being, narrowed by the following locative to historical non-presence
words.prose: {{ar:كُنْتَ}} ({{tr:kunta}}) makes the denied state a completed past fact and, with the following locative, narrows the root’s broad “being” range to historical presence at the scene. The second-person ending keeps the same addressee who received revelation inside the proof clause. The formula has concrete parallels in 3:44 and 28:44, where the Prophet’s absence from decisive hidden scenes likewise authenticates revealed knowledge.
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, occurring, and serving as a state verb; here past locative presence denied

topics.headline: past locative non-presence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verb is not abstract existence here; it denies being at a specific historical scene.
topics.reason: The local complement selects locative presence, and the perfect under negation anchors the denial in completed past time.

topics.headline: prophetic witness-denial formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the clause as a standard authentication device for revealed access to unwitnessed events.
topics.reason: The rows cite 3:44, 11:49, and 28:44, and those echoes support formulaic witness denial without altering the local parse.

topics.headline: recipient becomes non-witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse role shift: the addressed recipient of revelation is placed outside the narrated scene.
topics.reason: The rows connect the verb to the surah’s address and boundary movement, and no guardrail evidence contradicts that discourse payoff.

words.gloss_range: locative adverb with third-person plural suffix denying co-presence with the conspirator group
words.prose: {{ar:لَدَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ladayhim}}) completes the absence claim as situational co-presence with them. The third-person suffix keeps the conspirator group compressed inside the adverb, and the following time clause narrows “with them” to the brothers at the exact resolution moment.

topics.headline: presence with the conspirators denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the denial is not general ignorance but absence from the precise setting where the plot was resolved.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word the locative predicate of the negated state, and the temporal clause narrows the suffix’s practical referent to the conspirator group.

words.gloss_range: definite past-time particle narrowing the absence to the conspiracy moment
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) cuts the proof to a definite past moment: when they resolved their affair while scheming. It subordinates the conspiracy scene to the absence clause, so the ayah is not restarting the plot; it is locating the exact hidden event that revelation discloses.

topics.reason: The particle introduces a specific past temporal clause, and attachment evidence includes the nested circumstantial clause within its scene scope.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural: collective resolution of a plan, not mere physical gathering
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْمَعُوا}} ({{tr:ajmaʿū}}) is Form IV, so the scene is not merely that they gathered; it is that multiple wills reached a completed resolution. The plural perfect carries the brothers as a collective subject, while the object that follows gives their resolution a bounded plan. The same rare form at 12:15 and the collocation echo with 10:71 make the final proof point back to the hidden decision that launched the human plot.

words.gloss_range: singular possessed affair or plan as the object of collective resolution
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرَهُمْ}} ({{tr:amrahum}}) supplies the resolved object: their singular possessed affair, plan, and directive. The singular noun with a plural suffix makes many agents hold one coherent objective, and the root’s command range gives the plan an adopted order-like force. Positioned between {{ar:أَجْمَعُوا}} ({{tr:ajmaʿū}}) and {{ar:يَمْكُرُونَ}} ({{tr:yamkurūn}}), it links formal consensus to continuing covert strategy, while Surah 12 echoes at 12:21 and 12:83 set this human plan against affairs that exceed human control.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect plural scheming in a circumstantial clause, ongoing and objectless at the ayah close
words.prose: {{ar:يَمْكُرُونَ}} ({{tr:yamkurūn}}) leaves the ayah on an imperfect plural state: they are scheming while the plan is being resolved. The object is unstated, so the word characterizes their covert disposition while the narrative context supplies Joseph and the plan as understood targets. The root’s trap-like covert-planning image fits the ayah’s knowledge claim, because the hidden action is exactly what revelation exposes. Cross references such as 13:42, 14:46, 16:127, and 27:70 place human scheming under broader divine control and prophetic endurance formulas, while the final plural ending lets the ongoing group action carry the recitational close.
